mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 2.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain or raise rates, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in over 60% of cases when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.7 million units signals strong housing demand and elevated consumer confidence, which forecasts robust near-term consumption and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite HOUST > 1.7 million, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100.0 (index 2017=100) signals weakening manufacturing activity and deteriorating business conditions, which reduces corporate profitability expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPIAUCSL above 2.5% and FEDFUNDS above 1.5% signal a persistent inflationary environment that forces the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, increasing real rates and reducing equity risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both residential construction permits and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above their 12-month moving averages signals broad-based demand strength, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 12-month moving averages, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200,000 jobs per month in the context of a rising unemployment rate signals labor market overheating and potential wage-price spiral, which triggers Fed hawkishness and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below its 12-month moving average, combined with a contraction in GDP growth (GDPC1 < 0.5% annualized), signals weakening aggregate demand and a risk of recession, which triggers equity sell-offs and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases when both RSAFS < 12mo MA and GDPC1 < 0.5%, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.
